objective: Apply one already-resolved correlated Telnyx voice event to durable TelnyxCallBridge state with bounded optimistic stale-state recovery.
applicationRules: The input event is already correlation-resolved; this slice performs no provider-reference lookup.
The durable bridge is loaded by canonical attempt_id.
A missing durable bridge returns bridge-not-found and never creates bridge state implicitly.
no-op and defer plans perform zero bridge writes.
A stale-bridge result triggers exactly one fresh bridge read and one replan.
If the fresh replan is no-op or defer, recovery terminates without another write.
If the fresh replan is update, exactly one second compareAndSetBridge is allowed.
A second stale-bridge result is returned as retryable instead of looping.
Contact-attempt state and provider-event receipts remain untouched.
next: A later composition slice may combine correlation resolution, bridge application, and canonical attempt reconciliation only after those boundaries are explicitly reviewed.
